meta.title: One SQL statement locked this agent's failure. Replaying 50 futures finds the step.
meta.footer_left: forkscope · Qwen3-8B · SGLang deterministic inference · task t4, Chinook DB
meta.footer_right: K = 50 full replays per step, every tool call executed

body:
One SQL statement locked this agent's failure. Replaying 50 futures finds the step.

Task t4: albums per artist, 3 decimals (gold 1.701). In the transcript, no step looks wrong.

blocks.subtitle: Integer division returns 1 silently; the run closes confident and wrong.
